authority_basis.basis: The invariant coefficient-plus-selector result bears directly on the shared paired-object architecture and deck interpretation.

operations.title: Nima derives the intrinsic rank-two Kummer line and fifth selector
operations.body: Event 1216 identifies the invariant object behind event 1211. On the consistent rank-two locus, with plane Gram determinant Delta and R=d^T adj(H)d, w=2Delta*tau obeys w^2+R=0. This is an intrinsic anti-invariant Kummer line. A transverse fifth point gives the source-derived selector Nw=C_p and eliminant C_p^2+N^2R=0. This is a local positive case where geometry produces coefficient line plus selector together.
